Weekly Context & Takeaways

What Carried

Longs contributed +$923.00 and NYAM produced +$658.80. Average winners of +$268.00 substantially exceeded the -$86.38 average loser.

What Hurt

Wednesday and Friday both went 0-for-4. Three matched losses had already reached at least +1R MFE before reversing.

Story of the Week

SupDem finished +$1,021.10 despite losing 13 of 21 trades. A 38.1% WR was sufficient because average winner size was roughly 3.1x average loser size.
